settings.label: Commissions
settings.statement: One piece, for one person, made once.
settings.text:
We make exclusive pieces, each for one wearer, for a wedding, a festival or any other occasion. A commission begins with a conversation and is finalised in our Chennai studio.

You choose the cloth from our range. Kamalam draws the design from your own inspiration and vision: a family motif, a temple, a story, a photograph. It is a piece you dream of wearing, one that adds value to your occasion and is remembered for life.

settings.title: The conversation
settings.text: Write to us with the occasion and the date. Kamalam replies herself and, if the dates allow, we arrange a call or a studio visit.

settings.title: Cloth and design
settings.text: You choose the cloth from our range. Kamalam draws the design for your occasion and sends it to you. Nothing goes to the frame until you approve it.

settings.title: The embroidery
settings.text: Your piece is embroidered by hand by Sekhar in our Chennai studio. The kurta or shirt is cut to your measure. We tell you when the embroidery begins.

settings.title: Fitting and delivery
settings.text: One fitting, in Chennai or by measurement. Your piece is then sent to you by insured courier.

settings.label: How it works
settings.text: Each piece is agreed in conversation, then drawn, embroidered and fitted. A commission takes eight to ten weeks to make, once the conversation is complete and everything is finalised. We do not shorten that for a date.

settings.title: The wedding set
settings.text: Veshti, kurta and angavastram as one set, embroidered in zari, with motifs drawn for the family. The price and the dates are agreed after the first conversation.

settings.title: The cloth
settings.text: Chosen from our range of handloom fabrics.

settings.title: The design
settings.text: Drawn by Kamalam and approved by you, in writing.

settings.title: Price and dates
settings.text: Quoted once, in writing, after the design is approved. The price does not change.

settings.title: Deposit
settings.text: 30% once the design is approved. The balance at fitting, or before dispatch if you are fitted by measurement.

settings.title: Lead time
settings.text: Eight to ten weeks, from the day the conversation is complete and everything is finalised. This includes the drawing of the design. A date too close to allow this cannot be taken.

settings.title: Capacity
settings.text: A few commissions a season, so each gets the time it needs. Dates are taken in the order of first conversation.

settings.title: Returns
settings.text: A commission is made for one person and cannot be returned or exchanged. If the fit is not right, we alter it.

settings.label: Terms
settings.heading: What is agreed before work begins

settings.label: Write
settings.heading: Write to Kamalam
settings.text: Tell us the occasion, the date if it is fixed, and where you are. Or send the same on WhatsApp.
settings.reply_line: Kamalam replies herself, within one working day
